title: Growth gaps and exponential genericity in acylindrically hyperbolic groups
summary: Let $G$ be a finitely generated group acting by isometries on a geodesic metric space with two independent strongly contracting WPD elements. We prove that, for every finite generating set of $G$, strongly contracting WPD elements for this action are exponentially generic in word-metric balls. The proof establishes a growth gap for elements with small displacement relative to word length in an auxiliary projection complex.
